evals.prompt: I'm an admin and just created an MCP connector with slug linear_mcp. Give me the remaining steps to make it callable from a harness today. Do you need me to paste our OAuth client secret here?
evals.expected_output: Upgrade to kei 0.2.3 or later and log in; confirm activation and workspace admins group access; connect the admin's account using the connector ID and workspace name; make the first tool-list call from a harness; review and approve the candidate manifest; sync harness configuration and follow Codex hook trust guidance if using Codex.
expectations: Explains the ordered activation, per-user connect, first tool-list, manifest review and approval, and harness sync flow.
Uses the workspace name in the connect command.
States that the first tool-list call from a harness after connection creates the candidate manifest.
Directs the user to complete OAuth in the browser and says no secret needs to be sent.

checks.text: Explains the ordered activation, per-user connect, first tool-list, manifest review and approval, and harness sync flow.
checks.regex: (?:activate|activation|active)[\s\S]*(?:connect(?: the admin.s account)?|OAuth)[\s\S]*(?:first|initial)[\s\S]*(?:tool.?list|tools/list|list(?:ing)?(?: the server.s)? tools?)[\s\S]*(?:candidate )?manifest[\s\S]*(?:review|inspect|approve)[\s\S]*(?:kei )?harness sync

checks.text: Uses the workspace name in the connect command.
States that the first tool-list call from a harness after connection creates the candidate manifest.
Directs the user to complete OAuth in the browser and says no secret needs to be sent.
checks.regex: (?=[\s\S]*(?:complete|finish|authorize|sign in to)[\s\S]*OAuth[\s\S]*browser|browser[\s\S]*(?:complete|finish|authorize|OAuth))(?=[\s\S]*(?:no|not|never|do not|don\x27t)[\s\S]{0,70}(?:send|share|paste|provide|need to provide|need to send|secret|credential|token)|(?:secret|credential|token)[\s\S]{0,60}(?:not needed|not required|stay|remain)[\s\S]{0,40}(?:browser|private|with you))

evals.prompt: An MCP harness call returns HTTP 403 with reason connector_has_no_tools. Should I add an allow policy for this reason, or what should I do next?
evals.expected_output: A manifest has not been approved or available yet. Connect the admin account, make a first tool-list call from a harness to create the candidate manifest, inspect it, then approve it. Don't create a policy to fix this reason.
expectations: Identifies the missing tool manifest as the issue and directs the admin through first tool-list and review/approval.
Directs the admin to connect first as a workspace admin, then make the first harness tool-list call to create tools for this connector reason.

checks.text: Identifies the missing tool manifest as the issue and directs the admin through first tool-list and review/approval.
Directs the admin to connect first as a workspace admin, then make the first harness tool-list call to create tools for this connector reason.

evals.prompt: `kei connectors manifests list` says `No tool manifests yet`. The admin already ran `kei connectors connect`. Why is it empty?
evals.expected_output: Connect completes user OAuth but does not request tools or submit a manifest. The first harness tool-list call triggers manifest submission; run it, then list/show and approve the candidate.
expectations: States that the first tool-list call from a harness after connection creates the candidate manifest.
Gives next actions to call a tool-list and review/approve.

checks.text: States that the first tool-list call from a harness after connection creates the candidate manifest.
Gives next actions to call a tool-list and review/approve.
checks.regex: (?=[\s\S]*(?:first[\s-]+tool.?list|first[\s\S]*(?:tools/list|list tools)|tools/list|list tools|(?:kei )?connectors manifests list))(?=[\s\S]*(?:review[\s\S]{0,60}approve|approve[\s\S]{0,60}review|inspect[\s\S]{0,60}approve|manifests show[\s\S]{0,80}approve|connectors manifests approve))

evals.prompt: `kei harness sync` says policies are scoped to another harness and Codex hooks need trust. Does that mean my connector setup failed? What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Sync may still have succeeded. Explain that policies scoped to another harness won't be applied to this harness and require an admin to adjust policy scope if access is intended; Codex users should open Codex and run /hooks to trust the hooks. Avoid claiming sync grants policy access.
expectations: Explains the other-harness policy warning as a policy scope issue, separate from connector setup.
Does not claim harness sync creates or widens policies.

checks.text: Explains the other-harness policy warning as a policy scope issue, separate from connector setup.
Does not claim harness sync creates or widens policies.

evals.prompt: I created this connector last month and now connect returns `no_matching_policy`. I'm using workspace UUID as --workspace. How should I troubleshoot?
evals.expected_output: --workspace takes the workspace name; retry with the exact name. Older connectors may not have the creating-admin admins-group permit, so an admin must add the group permit. no_matching_policy is an access-policy issue; do not guess UUID support or silently make a production policy change.
expectations: Corrects workspace UUID to workspace name.
Identifies that older connectors may need a group permit added by an admin.
States production policy changes are the admin's decision.
Treats no_matching_policy as a policy issue rather than missing tools.

checks.text: Corrects workspace UUID to workspace name.
checks.regex: (?=[\s\S]*--workspace)(?=[\s\S]*(?:workspace name|workspace NAME|--workspace\s+<(?:(?:workspace[-_ ]?)?name)>|name instead of (?:the )?(?:UUID|ID)|use (?:the )?workspace name))(?=[\s\S]*(?:UUID|workspace ID|workspace id))

checks.text: Identifies that older connectors may need a group permit added by an admin.
States production policy changes are the admin's decision.
Treats no_matching_policy as a policy issue rather than missing tools.

evals.prompt: After activation, `kei connectors connect` fails with `no OAuth registration in this organization is for the resource's authorization server`. What does this mean? Do you need me to send you the OAuth client secret to fix it?
evals.expected_output: This is version-dependent. When the HAI-804 bridge auto-registration change is deployed, connect registers with the MCP server automatically. Before then the organization needs an OAuth registration for that authorization server; ask the platform owner to arrange it. Do not ask the user for OAuth secrets.
expectations: Marks auto-registration behavior as version-dependent and gives the pre-deployment remedy.
Directs the user to ask the platform owner to arrange organization OAuth registration.

checks.text: Marks auto-registration behavior as version-dependent and gives the pre-deployment remedy.
checks.regex: (?=[\s\S]*(?:version.?dependent|version|deployed|deployment|shipped|rollout|older version))(?=[\s\S]*(?:auto.?register|automatically register|registration))(?=[\s\S]*(?:before|older|until|prior to|not yet deployed|before that))(?=[\s\S]*(?:platform owner|OAuth registration|organization registration))

checks.text: Directs the user to ask the platform owner to arrange organization OAuth registration.
